questions.question: An 11-digit number 8732326687X is divisible by 18. What is the value of X?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by 18 if it is divisible by both 2 and 9.

Divisibility by 2 requires the last digit X to be even (0, 2, 4, 6, 8).

Among the given options (5, 3, 2, 1), only 2 is an even number.

Thus, X must be 2 to satisfy the first condition of divisibility by 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given number: 8732326687X

Condition: Number is divisible by 18.

Method: Check divisibility rules for 2 and 9 (since 18 = 2 × 9).

⇒ Divisibility by 9: Sum of digits must be divisible by 9.

⇒ Sum = 8 + 7 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 6 + 6 + 8 + 7 + X

⇒ Sum = 52 + X

⇒ The nearest multiple of 9 greater than 52 is 54 (9 × 6 = 54).

⇒ 52 + X = 54

⇒ X = 54 − 52 = 2

⇒ Divisibility by 2: The last digit X must be even. Since X = 2 is even, this condition is satisfied.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility by 2

A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even, i.e., 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8.

Composite Divisibility Rule

If a number is divisible by two co-prime numbers a and b, then it is also divisible by their product (a × b).</p

questions.question: A { runs } (5)/(2) { times as fast as } B. { If } A { gives } B { a start of } 80 { meters, how far from } A's { starting point should the winning post be so that } A { and } B { reach it at the same time?}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of speeds A : B = 5 : 2

Ratio of distances A : B = 5 : 2 (since time is constant)

Difference in distance units = 5 − 2 = 3 units

According to question, 3 units = 80 m (head start)

Winning post distance (A's distance) = 5 units = (80 ÷ 3) × 5 = 133¹/₃ m

**∴ The correct answer is 133¹/₃ m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of A = 5/2 × Speed of B

Head start given to B = 80 m

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f448251e41dac07d1e97e068340294ffb6034032120834189dbe25465266ca34.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of A / Speed of B = 5 / 2

⇒ Let the distance of the winning post from A's start be D meters.

⇒ Time taken by A = D ÷ SpeedA

⇒ Time taken by B = (D − 80) ÷ SpeedB

⇒ Since they reach at the same time: D / SpeedA = (D − 80) / SpeedB

⇒ D / (D − 80) = SpeedA / SpeedB = 5 / 2

⇒ 2 × D = 5 × (D − 80)

⇒ 2D = 5D − 400

⇒ 3D = 400

⇒ D = 400 / 3 = 133¹/₃ m

**∴ The correct answer is 133¹/₃ m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Time Property

If two bodies take the same time to cover different distances, the ratio of their distances is equal to the ratio of their speeds: D₁/D₂ = S₁/S₂.

Concept of Head Start

In a race of length L, if A gives B a start of x meters, A has to run L meters while B has to run only (L − x) meters.

Dead Heat

A race is said to end in a dead heat if all participants reach the winning post at exactly the same time.</p

questions.question: The angle of elevation of the top of a tower from a point on the ground 48 m from the foot of the tower is 30°. Find the height of the tower in metres.****
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°−60°−90° triangle, the ratio of sides Height : Base : Hypotenuse is 1 : √3 : 2.

Side opposite to 60° (Base) = 48 m.

√3 units = 48 m

1 unit (Height) = 48/√3 = (16 × 3)/√3 = 16√3 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 16√3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Distance of the point from the foot of the tower (Base) = 48 m

Angle of elevation (θ) = 30°

Formula used: tan θ = Perpendicular (Height) / Base

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/714f10c4dbb9dd9f764e3e16d5a58826c04a67d55efc3fe8c96af1032a4e430f.png] 

⇒ Let the height of the tower be h.

⇒ tan 30° = h / 48

⇒ 1/√3 = h / 48

⇒ h = 48 / √3

⇒ h = (16 × 3) / √3

⇒ h = 16√3 m

**∴ The correct answer is 16√3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios for Standard Angles

Standard values: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, and tan 60° = √3.

Angle of Elevation

It is the angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when the object being viewed is above the horizontal level.

30°−60°−90° Triangle Property

The side opposite to 30° is x, the side opposite to 60° is x√3, and the hypotenuse is 2x.</p

questions.question: What is the L.C.M. of 45, 63 and 81?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Factorize the numbers using the largest common factor:

45 = 9 × 5

63 = 9 × 7

81 = 9 × 9

LCM = 9 × (Remaining factors: 5 × 7 × 9)

LCM = 9 × 315 = 2835

**∴ The correct answer is 2835.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 45, 63, and 81.

**Formula Used:** LCM by Prime Factorization Method (Product of highest powers of all prime factors).

⇒ Prime factors of 45 = 3 × 3 × 5 = 3² × 5¹

⇒ Prime factors of 63 = 3 × 3 × 7 = 3² × 7¹

⇒ Prime factors of 81 = 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 3⁴

⇒ LCM = Highest powers of involved primes (3, 5, 7)

⇒ LCM = 3⁴ × 5¹ × 7¹

⇒ LCM = 81 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 81 × 35 = 2835

**∴ The correct answer is 2835.**

**__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The HCF is the largest positive integer that divides each of the numbers without a remainder. For 45, 63, and 81, the HCF is 9.

Relationship for Two Numbers

For any two positive integers a and b, HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b. This rule does not directly apply to more than two numbers.

LCM of Fractions

LCM of Fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators). This is essential for simplifying fraction-based arithmetic.</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks an article at ₹x and offers a discount of 54% on the marked price. He sells it for ₹437 after charging VAT of 52% on the discounted price. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use multiplying factors for discount and VAT: MP × (100 − D)% × (100 + VAT)% = Final SP

x × 0.46 × 1.52 = 437

x = 437 / (0.46 × 1.52)

x = 437 / 0.6992 = 625

**∴ The correct answer is 625.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹x

Discount = 54% | VAT = 52% | Final SP = ₹437

**Formula Used:**

Price after tax = Price before tax × (1 + Tax/100)

Selling Price before tax = MP × (1 − Discount/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d809587d8e063f726d363001020707876d55f892bdd2bcf3a08984e0f3ef30aa.png] 

⇒ Price after discount = Final SP ÷ (1 + VAT/100)

⇒ Price after discount = 437 ÷ 1.52 = 287.5

⇒ Marked Price (x) = Price after discount ÷ (1 − Discount/100)

⇒ x = 287.5 ÷ (1 − 0.54)

⇒ x = 287.5 ÷ 0.46

⇒ x = 625

**∴ The correct answer is 625.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed by a% and then by b%, the effective change is [a + b + (ab/100)]%.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP), while Profit or Loss is calculated on the Cost Price (CP).

VAT and Taxes

Value Added Tax (VAT) or GST is usually applied to the net selling price after all discounts have been deducted.

questions.question: By how much is 60% of 45 greater than (1)/(5) of 45?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert 1/5 to percentage: 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

Both percentages are calculated on the same base value (45).

Difference in percentage = 60% − 20% = 40%.

Required difference = 40% of 45.

Required difference = 0.4 × 45 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Main number = 45

Formula Used: Value = (Percentage/100) × Number | Value = Fraction × Number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fd65e15d779eea0389f43c9cd88989e2ac1a786272b83f5da403fa58351dcdf.png] 

⇒ First value = 60% of 45

⇒ First value = (60/100) × 45 = 0.6 × 45 = 27

⇒ Second value = 1/5 of 45

⇒ Second value = (1/5) × 45 = 9

⇒ Difference = 27 − 9

⇒ Difference = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide by 100. Example: 60% = 60/100 = 3/5.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert a fraction to a percentage, multiply by 100. Example: 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

Common Base Property

If multiple percentages or fractions are applied to the same number, we can subtract or add the proportions directly before multiplying with the base value.</p

questions.question: The average price of three items of furniture is ₹16,425. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the price of the costliest item (in ₹) will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of prices = 3 : 5 : 7 ⇒ Total ratio units = 3 + 5 + 7 = 15 units.

Total price = Average × Number of items = 16,425 × 3.

15 units = 16,425 × 3 ⇒ 5 units = 16,425.

1 unit = 3,285.

Costliest item (7 units) = 7 × 3,285 = 22,995.

**∴ The correct answer is 22,995.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average price of 3 items = ₹16,425

Ratio of prices = 3 : 5 : 7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58375fb82da985119a7bc1766430fb3a6aaf204551ca2e68728ad0b56dabe743.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Value = Average × Number of items

Value of a part = (Ratio of that part / Sum of Ratios) × Total Value

**Calculations:**

Let the prices of the three items be 3x, 5x, and 7x.

⇒ Total Price = 3x + 5x + 7x = 15x

⇒ Average = Total Price ÷ 3

⇒ 16,425 = 15x ÷ 3

⇒ 16,425 = 5x

⇒ x = 16,425 ÷ 5

⇒ x = 3,285

⇒ Price of the costliest item = 7x

⇒ Price = 7 × 3,285

⇒ Price = 22,995

**∴ The correct answer is 22,995.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

The average of a set of observations is the sum of observations divided by the total number of observations. Sum = Average × n.

Ratio and Proportion

If a total amount A is divided into parts according to ratio a : b : c, then the value of the largest part is [max(a,b,c) / (a+b+c)] × A.

Weighted Average

When items have different weights w₁, w₂, the combined average is (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂).

questions.question:
The volume of a solid cylinder is 2926 cm³ and its height is 19 cm. What is the total surface area of the solid cylinder?

( {Use } pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of a cylinder is 2πr(h + r), which involves π (22/7).

The answer must be a multiple of 11.

Check options for 11 divisibility: 1144 → (1+4) − (1+4) = 0 (Divisible by 11).

Other options: 1121 (1), 1175 (2), 1106 (6) are not divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 1144 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of cylinder (V) = 2926 cm³

Height (h) = 19 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume (V) = πr²h

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96bcfeb79e5b3d124aa16177ae77a1e0f4d1c1bec39a3a0882b365e9447751ad.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = πr²h = 2926

⇒ (22/7) × r² × 19 = 2926

⇒ r² = (2926 × 7) / (22 × 19)

⇒ r² = (154 × 7) / 22

⇒ r² = 7 × 7

⇒ r = 7 cm

⇒ TSA = 2πr(h + r)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (19 + 7)

⇒ TSA = 44 × 26

⇒ TSA = 1144 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1144 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral surface area of a cylinder excluding its top and bottom bases is given by 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the area of the curved surface and the areas of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The capacity or space occupied by a solid cylinder is V = πr²h.</p

questions.question: Find the single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 5% and 8%.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Successive Discount Formula = x + y − (x × y)/100

Where x = 5% and y = 8%

Net Discount = 5 + 8 − (5 × 8)/100

Net Discount = 13 − 40/100 = 13 − 0.4 = 12.6%

**∴ The correct answer is 12.6%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: First discount (d₁) = 5%, Second discount (d₂) = 8%

Formula: Final Selling Price = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94304795516e51e5bc61aad2258b2e894ccf97c7ee55cbf34862309360d4d268.png] 

Let the Marked Price (MP) be 100 units.

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − (5% of 100) = 100 − 5 = 95 units.

⇒ Final Selling Price (SP) after 2nd discount = 95 − (8% of 95)

⇒ SP = 95 − (8 × 95)/100 = 95 − 7.6 = 87.4 units.

⇒ Total Discount = MP − SP = 100 − 87.4 = 12.6 units.

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount % = (12.6/100) × 100 = 12.6%

**∴ The correct answer is 12.6%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount for Three Rates

For three discounts a%, b%, and c%, the net discount is calculated as 100 − [100 × (1 − a/100) × (1 − b/100) × (1 − c/100)].

Profit/Loss and Discounts

Marked Price (MP) = CP × (100 + Profit%)/(100 − Discount%). This relates the cost price to the marked price via the profit and discount percentages.

Successive Percentage Change

The net change for successive increases/decreases x and y is given by the formula x + y + (xy/100), where negative signs are used for decreases.</p

questions.question: The average of 6.5, 10.7, 20.2 and a is 17. The value of a is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Assume the average for all 4 numbers is 17.

Net deviation from the average must be 0.

Deviations: (6.5 − 17) = −10.5, (10.7 − 17) = −6.3, (20.2 − 17) = +3.2.

Sum of deviations = −10.5 − 6.3 + 3.2 = −13.6.

To balance, value of a = 17 + 13.6 = 30.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 30.6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 6.5, 10.7, 20.2, and a

Average = 17

Total count (n) = 4

**Formula:**

Average = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891369efb811968b7ed72a6bd145ec09dbf8b506d59fbbfae9a30401ced2d129.png] 

⇒ Average = (6.5 + 10.7 + 20.2 + a) ÷ 4

⇒ 17 = (37.4 + a) ÷ 4

⇒ 17 × 4 = 37.4 + a

⇒ 68 = 37.4 + a

⇒ a = 68 − 37.4

⇒ a = 30.6

**∴ The correct answer is 30.6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The most common type of average, calculated by dividing the sum of all values by the total number of values.

Sum of Deviations

The sum of deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero: ∑(xᵢ − Average) = 0.

Weighted Average

Used when different values have different levels of importance or frequency: Average = ∑(wᵢ × xᵢ) ÷ ∑wᵢ.</p

questions.question: ₹8,442 is divided among S, B, and C in such a way that if ₹7, ₹73, and ₹68 be deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 6 : 7 : 16. Find the difference between the B’s and C’s original shares.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net Amount = 8442 − (7 + 73 + 68) = 8294

Total Ratio Units = 6 + 7 + 16 = 29 units

Value of 1 unit = 8294 ÷ 29 = 286

Ratio difference (C − B) = 16 − 7 = 9 units

Difference in shares = (9 × 286) + (68 − 73) = 2574 − 5 = 2569

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,569.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Amount = ₹8,442

Deductions: S = ₹7, B = ₹73, C = ₹68

New Ratio S : B : C = 6 : 7 : 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abe62e9deb5bd8a0844fe413466e048e9830e887b25c2d84495594c72a29a110.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Deductions = 7 + 73 + 68 = ₹148

⇒ Remaining amount = 8442 − 148 = ₹8,294

⇒ 29 units = 8294

⇒ 1 unit = 8294 ÷ 29 = 286

⇒ B's original share = (7 × 286) + 73 = 2002 + 73 = ₹2,075

⇒ C's original share = (16 × 286) + 68 = 4576 + 68 = ₹4,644

⇒ Difference = 4644 − 2075 = ₹2,569

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,569.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio Division with Constants

If (A−x):(B−y):(C−z) = a:b:c, then the sum (A+B+C) − (x+y+z) is distributed in the ratio a:b:c.

Difference between Shares

Difference between A and B = |(a × k + x) − (b × k + y)|, where k is the value of one ratio unit.

Compounded Ratio

The compounded ratio of a:b and c:d is (a×c):(b×d).

questions.concept: Linear Equation in 2 or more Variables
questions.question:
The cost of 4 keychains and 3 wallets is ₹ 75. The cost of 2 keychains and 2 wallets is ₹ 48.
What is the cost of 3 keychains and 1 wallet?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From 2K + 2W = 48, we get 1 Keychain (K) + 1 Wallet (W) = 24.

Multiply by 3: 3K + 3W = 72.

Subtracting this from (4K + 3W = 75): (4K − 3K) = 75 − 72 ⇒ K = 3.

Since K + W = 24, then W = 24 − 3 = 21.

Cost of 3K + 1W = 3(3) + 21 = 9 + 21 = 30.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4 × Cost of Keychain (K) + 3 × Cost of Wallet (W) = ₹ 75 --- (i)

2 × Cost of Keychain (K) + 2 × Cost of Wallet (W) = ₹ 48 --- (ii)

**Formula Used:**

Linear equations in two variables: a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdb3b5aee5044d5426176c6b16e1514d14f716ad9fd60393ef7a7ccc61fe27a3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ From (ii), divide by 2: K + W = 24

⇒ W = 24 − K --- (iii)

⇒ Substitute (iii) in (i): 4K + 3(24 − K) = 75

⇒ 4K + 72 − 3K = 75

⇒ K + 72 = 75

⇒ K = 75 − 72 = 3

⇒ Put K = 3 in (iii): W = 24 − 3 = 21

⇒ Required Cost = 3K + 1W

⇒ Required Cost = 3(3) + 21

⇒ Required Cost = 9 + 21 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Elimination Method

A process of solving equations by adding or subtracting them to cancel out one variable, usually after multiplying one or both by constant factors.

Substitution Method

Expressing one variable in terms of the other from one equation and substituting this expression into the second equation.

Nature of Solutions

A system has a unique solution if a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂, no solution if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂, and infinite solutions if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂.

questions.question: The ratio of the present ages of two friends, A and B, is 3:4. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 7:10. Find their present ages.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present Ratio = 3 : 4 (Difference = 1); Past Ratio (4 yrs ago) = 7 : 10 (Difference = 3).

Equalize differences by multiplying present ratio by 3 → 9 : 12.

Change in units: 9 − 7 = 2 units (or 12 − 10 = 2 units).

2 units = 4 years ⇒ 1 unit = 2 years.

Present ages: A = 9 × 2 = 18 years and B = 12 × 2 = 24 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 years and 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Present ratio of A and B = 3 : 4. Ratio 4 years ago = 7 : 10.

**Formula:** Age = Ratio Part × Common Multiplier (x).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1671ce4d59dc5b5db81bf4b0298e38996d74eca80f04fce5f349d4ec16869f65.png] 

Let the present ages of A and B be 3x and 4x respectively.

⇒ (3x − 4) / (4x − 4) = 7 / 10

⇒ 10 × (3x − 4) = 7 × (4x − 4)

⇒ 30x − 40 = 28x − 28

⇒ 30x − 28x = 40 − 28

⇒ 2x = 12

⇒ x = 6

⇒ Present age of A = 3 × 6 = 18 years

⇒ Present age of B = 4 × 6 = 24 years

**∴ The correct answer is 18 years and 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The numerical difference between the ages of two individuals remains constant regardless of the number of years passed or preceding.

Ratio Balancing Method

If the difference between ratio parts is not the same, multiply the ratios by the difference of the opposite ratio to balance the units.

Future and Past Ages

If present age is x, age after n years = x + n; age n years ago = x − n.</p

questions.question: A sold an article to B at a loss of 12%. B sold it to C at a profit of 20%. If C paid ₹1,122 to B, find the cost price of the article for A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive multiplier = (1 − 0.12) × (1 + 0.20) = 0.88 × 1.2 = 1.056.

Let Cost Price of A be x.

x × 1.056 = 1,122.

x = 1,122 ÷ 1.056 = 1,062.50.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,062.50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Loss % (A to B) = 12%, Profit % (B to C) = 20%, Amount paid by C = ₹1,122.

Formula: CP = SP ÷ [(1 ± R₁/100) × (1 ± R₂/100)]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4635490bfb767e3555c0c3694401948549339bc504c60a9d6beeb138d85b0038.png] 

⇒ Let CP for A = x

⇒ SP for A (which is CP for B) = x × (100 − 12) / 100 = 0.88x

⇒ SP for B (which is CP for C) = 0.88x × (100 + 20) / 100

⇒ 1,122 = 0.88x × 1.20

⇒ 1,122 = 1.056x

⇒ x = 1,122 / 1.056

⇒ x = 1,062.50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,062.50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Net percentage change for two successive changes of a% and b% is given by [a + b + (ab/100)]%.

Cost Price Formula

To find CP when SP and Profit% are given: CP = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 + Profit%]. For loss, replace + with −.

Ratio Method

Convert percentages to fractions: 12% loss = 22/25 multiplier; 20% profit = 6/5 multiplier. Initial CP = Final SP × (25/22) × (5/6).

questions.question: The compound interest on ₹5,625 for 6 months at 16% per annum, interest being compounded quarterly is:

For quarterly compounding, Rate = 16% ÷ 4 = 4% per quarter.

Time = 6 months = 2 quarters.

Effective interest rate for 2 quarters = 4 + 4 + (4 × 4)/100 = 8.16%.

CI = 5625 × 8.16% = 459.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹459.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Principal (P) = ₹5,625

Rate (R) = 16% per annum

Time (T) = 6 months

Formula Used: Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ; CI = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9f9299dd6521b8c9bacac83b1ce77a1a1173537d69a98a02b0432ee2bdb0ce0.png] 

Since interest is compounded quarterly:

⇒ Quarterly Rate (r) = 16% ÷ 4 = 4%

⇒ Number of quarters (n) = 6 months ÷ 3 months = 2

⇒ A = 5625 × (1 + 4/100)²

⇒ A = 5625 × (26/25) × (26/25)

⇒ A = 5625 × (676/625)

⇒ A = 9 × 676 = 6084

⇒ CI = 6084 − 5625 = 459

**∴ The correct answer is ₹459.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Quarterly Compounding

When interest is compounded quarterly, the annual rate is divided by 4 and the time in years is multiplied by 4.

Effective Rate of Interest

For two periods with rate r, the effective rate is r + r + (r × r)/100.

Compound Interest for Half-Yearly

If compounded half-yearly, the rate is halved (R/2) and the time is doubled (2T).

questions.question: Simplify (6pq + 14q)² - (6pq - 14q)².
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply algebraic identity: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab

Let a = 6pq and b = 14q

Required result = 4 × (6pq) × (14q)

⇒ 24 × 14 × p × q × q = 336pq²

**∴ The correct answer is 336pq².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: (6pq + 14q)² − (6pq − 14q)²

Formula used: x² − y² = (x + y)(x − y)

⇒ [(6pq + 14q) + (6pq − 14q)] × [(6pq + 14q) − (6pq − 14q)]

⇒ [6pq + 14q + 6pq − 14q] × [6pq + 14q − 6pq + 14q]

⇒ [12pq] × [28q]

⇒ 12 × 28 × p × q × q

⇒ 336pq²

**∴ The correct answer is 336pq².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities of Squares

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.

Sum and Difference of Squares

(a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²) while (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

Factorization Identity

a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b). This is useful for simplifying expressions involving difference of squares.</p

questions.question: If the numerator of a fraction is increased by 25% and the denominator is decreased by 9%, the value of new fraction becomes (5)/(7) . Which of the following is the correct statement w.r.t. the original fraction?6591

options.text: The difference between denominator and numerator is 12
The sum of numerator and denominator is 37
The numerator is greater than denominator by 10

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let original fraction be N/D.

New fraction = (125% of N) / (91% of D) = 5/7

N/D = (5/7) × (91/125)

N/D = (1/1) × (13/25) = 13/25

Denominator − Numerator = 25 − 13 = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is The difference between denominator and numerator is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numerator increase = 25%

Denominator decrease = 9%

Resulting fraction = 5/7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d63a501d81d6e38d0c6fbd715a8bb394460a5d365ca12166a77b669b16e50ca.png] 

Let the original fraction be x/y.

⇒ According to the question:

⇒ [x × (100 + 25)/100] / [y × (100 − 9)/100] = 5/7

⇒ (x × 125/100) / (y × 91/100) = 5/7

⇒ 125x / 91y = 5/7

⇒ x/y = (5 × 91) / (7 × 125)

⇒ x/y = 455 / 875

⇒ x/y = 13 / 25

⇒ Original Numerator = 13, Original Denominator = 25

⇒ Checking statements:

⇒ Denominator − Numerator = 25 − 13 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is The difference between denominator and numerator is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change in Fractions

To find the original fraction given a percentage change, use the formula: Original × (New% Numerator / New% Denominator) = Final Fraction.

Proper and Improper Fractions

A fraction is proper if the numerator is less than the denominator (e.g., 13/25), and improper if the numerator is greater than or equal to the denominator.

Ratio Comparison

If the numerator increases and the denominator decreases, the value of the fraction always increases.</p

questions.question: Arman runs 8.8 km in 1 hour 20 minutes. How long will he take to run 26.4 km at double the previous speed?3797
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New distance is 3 times the old distance (26.4 ÷ 8.8 = 3).

New speed is 2 times the old speed.

Since Time = Distance ÷ Speed, the new time factor = 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5.

Initial time = 1 hour 20 minutes = 80 minutes.

New time = 80 × 1.5 = 120 minutes = 2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Distance₁ = 8.8 km, Time₁ = 1 hour 20 min, Distance₂ = 26.4 km, Speed₂ = 2 × Speed₁.

Formula used: Speed = Distance ÷ Time | Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/044110715bac83cd09911594141575fd43155c5b8266af31830d7958e202d5e2.png] 

⇒ Time₁ = 1 + 20/60 = 1 + 1/3 = 4/3 hours

⇒ Speed₁ = 8.8 ÷ (4/3) = (8.8 × 3) ÷ 4 = 2.2 × 3 = 6.6 kmph

⇒ Speed₂ = 2 × 6.6 = 13.2 kmph

⇒ Time₂ = Distance₂ ÷ Speed₂

⇒ Time₂ = 26.4 ÷ 13.2 = 2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time-Distance Proportionality

When speed is constant, Distance ∝ Time. When distance is constant, Speed ∝ 1/Time. When time is constant, Distance ∝ Speed.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert kmph to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to kmph, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question:
Solve the following. 

 [ (1)/(6) times {(36 div 6) + (9 div 3) - 3} + 18 ]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the innermost bracket expressions first: (36 ÷ 6) = 6 and (9 ÷ 3) = 3.

Simplify the terms inside the braces: {6 + 3 − 3} = 6.

Multiply the result by the outer fraction: 1/6 × 6 = 1.

Add the final constant term: 1 + 18 = 19.

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: [1/6 × {(36 ÷ 6) + (9 ÷ 3) − 3} + 18]

Method: Apply BODMAS rule (Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction).

⇒ [1/6 × {6 + 3 − 3} + 18]

⇒ [1/6 × {9 − 3} + 18]

⇒ [1/6 × 6 + 18]

⇒ 1 + 18

⇒ 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the order of operations: Brackets (), Orders (roots/powers), Division (÷), Multiplication (×), Addition (+), and Subtraction (−).

Types of Brackets

Solve brackets in the order: Parentheses ( ), then Curly Braces { }, and finally Square Brackets [ ].

Division Shortcut

Division is the same as multiplication by the reciprocal. For example, a ÷ b = a × (1/b).</p

questions.question: If the ages of 2 members of a family are in the ratio 6:1, and the average of their ages is 35 years. Find the total of their ages after 11 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total current age of 2 members = Average × Number of members = 35 × 2 = 70 years.

In 11 years, each member's age increases by 11.

Total increase in sum for 2 members = 2 × 11 = 22 years.

Total age after 11 years = Current sum + Total increase = 70 + 22 = 92 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 92 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Ratio of ages = 6:1

Average age = 35 years

Formula used: Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98efbd7c4ef74918b6206fc42e946f50b26f09f2ff62b60a6ff0cf1c02eb7b37.png] 

Let the current ages of the two members be 6x and x respectively.

⇒ Average = (6x + x) ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 7x ÷ 2 = 35

⇒ 7x = 70

⇒ x = 10

⇒ Present ages: Member 1 = 6 × 10 = 60 years | Member 2 = 1 × 10 = 10 years

⇒ Age of Member 1 after 11 years = 60 + 11 = 71 years

⇒ Age of Member 2 after 11 years = 10 + 11 = 21 years

⇒ Total age after 11 years = 71 + 21 = 92 years

**∴ The correct answer is 92 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum and Average Relation

Total sum of ages is always equal to the Average multiplied by the total number of individuals (Sum = Avg × n).

Future Sum of Ages

If there are 'n' people, the total sum of their ages after 't' years will increase by (n × t).

Ratio and Sum

If the ratio of two quantities is a:b, then their sum can be represented as k(a + b), where k is a constant factor.</p

questions.question: A field is in the shape of a quadrilateral. One of its diagonals is 10 m long. The perpendicular distances from the other two vertices to this diagonal are 12 m and 13 m, respectively. What is the area of the field?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a general quadrilateral = 1/2 × Diagonal × (Sum of perpendiculars)

Diagonal (d) = 10 m, Perpendiculars h₁ = 12 m, h₂ = 13 m

Area = 1/2 × 10 × (12 + 13)

Area = 5 × 25 = 125 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 125 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of diagonal (d) = 10 m

Perpendicular offsets (h₁ and h₂) = 12 m and 13 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of Quadrilateral = Area of Triangle₁ + Area of Triangle₂

Area = (1/2 × base × height₁) + (1/2 × base × height₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/050b4c4960db99d848cc531a779ff71fa9ab903cec3465ce40269204918af517.png] 

⇒ Area = 1/2 × d × (h₁ + h₂)

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 10 × (12 + 13)

⇒ Area = 5 × 25

⇒ Area = 125 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 125 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Rhombus

When both diagonals are known, Area = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂.

Area of Trapezium

Area = 1/2 × (sum of parallel sides) × h, where h is the distance between them.

Area of Parallelogram

Area = base × height. Also, if two adjacent sides a, b and the angle θ between them are given, Area = ab sinθ.

Area of Cyclic Quadrilateral

Area = √[(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)(s−d)], where s is the semi-perimeter (a+b+c+d)/2.</p

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 8 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 20 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill three-fourth of the same cistern with water?1241
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of cistern = LCM (8, 20) = 40 units

Efficiency of (P + Q) = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 units/hr

Efficiency of P = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 units/hr

Efficiency of Q = (P + Q) − P = 5 − 2 = 3 units/hr

3/4th of capacity = 40 × 3/4 = 30 units

Time taken by Q = 30 ÷ 3 = 10 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (P + Q) = 8 hours

Time taken by P = 20 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Pipes

 Efficiency

⇒ Efficiency of P = 40 ÷ 20 = 2

⇒ Combined Efficiency of P and Q = 40 ÷ 8 = 5

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 5 − 2 = 3

⇒ Total work to be done = 3/4 of the cistern capacity

⇒ Required Work = 40 × (3/4) = 30 units

⇒ Time taken by Q = Required Work ÷ Efficiency of Q

⇒ Time taken by Q = 30 ÷ 3 = 10 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If P takes x hours and Q takes y hours, their efficiencies are 1/x and 1/y respectively.

Pipes and Cisterns Basic Formula

If an inlet pipe fills in A hours and another fills in B hours, they together fill in (A × B) ÷ (A + B) hours.

Negative Work (Outlet/Leakage)

If a pipe empties the tank, its efficiency is taken as negative in the total efficiency calculation.</p

questions.question:
Three people, X, Y and Z, are working together to plant trees in a garden. X and Y together can complete the job in 20 days. Y and Z together can complete the job in 24 days. Z and X together can complete the job in 30 days.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of (20, 24, 30) = 120 units (Total Work).

Efficiencies: (X+Y) = 6, (Y+Z) = 5, (Z+X) = 4.

Combined efficiency 2(X+Y+Z) = 6 + 5 + 4 = 15.

Efficiency (X+Y+Z) = 15 ÷ 2 = 7.5.

Days taken = 120 ÷ 7.5 = 16 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 days.**

Calculations:

⇒ Total efficiency of (X+Y) + (Y+Z) + (Z+X) = 6 + 5 + 4

⇒ 2(X + Y + Z) efficiency = 15 units/day

⇒ (X + Y + Z) efficiency = 15 ÷ 2 = 7.5 units/day

⇒ Time taken by (X + Y + Z) together = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time = 120 ÷ 7.5

⇒ Time = 16 days

**∴ The correct answer is 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept is identical to Time and Work, where an inlet pipe has positive efficiency and an outlet pipe (leak) has negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the work actually done by each person (which is efficiency × time).

Combined Efficiency Rule

When individuals work in pairs (A+B, B+C, C+A), the sum of their efficiencies is twice the efficiency of all three working together: 2(A+B+C) = ΣEfficiencies.</p
